$comment: What a registry shows of each npm package beside its name and description, read by packages/tools/src/npm-metadata.js (`pnpm generate`), which writes `homepage`, `bugs`, `keywords` and, for an MCP server, `mcpName` into the package's package.json. Keyed by the package's directory under packages/. `docs` is the package's page on the docs site (tanrei.config.json `site`), `keywords` its search words; the namespace is added to them by the generator. `mcpServer`: the package is an MCP server, named in the MCP registry as io.github.<the repository's owner>/<the namespace>.
